en: A vintage sepia-tone postcard showing a large ornamental fountain complex in a landscaped park. In the foreground are multi-level basins and water jets with many people, including children and adults in early 20th‑century clothing, strolling around. In the background stands a curved colonnaded structure with statues and decorative stonework. At the top left, printed text identifies the location as Berlin and names the fountain.
